purpose: Throwaway compatibility evidence only; not a production validator, backtester, runner, registry, ledger, or evidence truth.

quantresearch_frozen_facts.adjustment: split-adjusted OHLC derived by adjusted_close / raw_close
quantresearch_frozen_facts.pit: fixture bars only; no future rows

unsupported_intraday.reason: The loader accepts two timestamp keys but the v2.0.1 engine and metrics treat each row as a daily decision period; accepting the shape does not preserve 1m semantics.

instrument_identifier.evidence: The public loader preserves the opaque AAPL.XNAS string, but defines no canonical venue/instrument identity contract.

calendar_sessions.evidence: The supplied date sequence is preserved, while calendar identity remains outside TradingData.

daily_frequency.evidence: Daily dates execute as intended, but no frequency field binds their meaning.

adjusted_ohlc.evidence: Observed adjusted OHLC exactly equals raw OHLC multiplied by adjusted_close/raw_close; the adjustment policy identity remains external.

raw_volume.evidence: The two supplied raw share-volume integers were returned unchanged.

as_of_identity.evidence: TradingData has no as-of field; the frozen owner fact can accompany, but cannot be independently enforced by, FINSABER.

pit_availability.evidence: Date-first access prevents direct future-row queries in this fixture, but no availability timestamp or PIT lineage is represented.

missing_bar_semantics.evidence: TradingData does not distinguish holiday, listing boundary, exclusion, or data incident; engine iteration uses only present keys.

provider_provenance.evidence: Provider and immutable snapshot identity are not part of the public TradingData contract or result config.

intraday_frequency.evidence: The real loader accepted two intraday keys without a frequency contract although annualization is fixed to 252 periods.

candidate.rule: On the first frozen daily bar, request a market buy of exactly 10 shares; make no later strategy request.

strategy_interface.evidence: The frozen rule was rewritten as a FINSABER BaseStrategyIso subclass; no Strategy Package executes unchanged.

signal_behavior.evidence: The first supplied bar produced exactly one buy request and no later candidate request.

decision_time.evidence: The strategy receives a date-level daily dictionary with no explicit exchange timestamp; the fixture interprets observation as end-of-session.

warm_up.evidence: The Python engine rejects every run shorter than 21 rows independently of the candidate's declared warm-up.

next_open.evidence: The 2024-01-02 signal filled on 2024-01-03 at the independently expected adjusted open 101.0.

market_order_action.evidence: A fixed-share market intent maps to framework.buy, but there is no typed order intent carrying venue or time-in-force.

fill_price.evidence: With zero costs, the observed entry price equals the next adjusted open exactly.

fixed_share_sizing.evidence: The requested and executed entry quantity are both 10 shares.

entry.evidence: The entry signal date, execution date, side, quantity, and price match the worked fixture.

forced_terminal_exit.evidence: FINSABER injected a final-close sell on 2024-01-31 although the candidate made no exit request, and force=True bypasses liquidity limits.
